shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ----; ls -R /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui; echo ----; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo ----; ls /home/sandbox/workspace; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; rg -n -C 4 -i 'calendar|date-components|date-utils' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120; echo ----; find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}'; echo ----; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components @gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -15; grep -A3 '"@gravity-ui' package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | grep -E '"version"|peerDependencies' -A6 | head -30

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tail -15; for v in 3.3.0 3.4.0 3.5.0 3.6.0 4.0.0 4.1.0 4.2.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null; done

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -A4 '"@gravity-ui' package.json | head -8; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; cat $D/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; echo "---- README setup"; rg -n -i -C 6 'required setup|install|import .*css|styles' $D/README.md | head -60; echo "---- components"; ls $D/dist/docs/components; echo "---- Calendar doc"; cat $D/dist/docs/components/Calendar/README.md 2>/dev/null || find $D/dist/docs -iname '*calendar*'; echo "---- traps"; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; cat $D/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md; echo "---- date-utils exports"; rg -n 'export' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; rg -n -C 2 'Russian|loadLocale|ru' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/README.md | head -30
